science_interpretation.positive: On both new DEV seeds, the research-sidecar inferred source-hidden singleton exception state partitions AND the true action effect operators before the last scored probe in all four world instances: modular-add-state0-exception in world0 and XOR-state3-exception in world1. This extends CKAD48's fixed named XOR-only grammar. science_interpretation.decisive_negative: The new learned-hypothesis hard gate scored essentially identical to the separately source-trained exact full 16-structure Bayesian comparator. Its gains against independently fully fitted unconstrained tabular were only 0.0009764 and 0.0041212, below the precommitted 0.010 improvement on BOTH original DEV cohorts. It therefore fails scientific DEV qualification, despite apparently correct structural identification.
science_interpretation.fairness: All arms receive the same genuinely observed two interventions+one terminal consequence per real source episode. The evaluator alone accesses private physics; exhaustive expected Brier readouts never train the learners. Additional structural enumeration and readout cost is not matched; source-action/information parity does not prove compute efficiency.
science_interpretation.limitations: This is a finite 16-hypothesis feature/physics search. Although correct state singleton partition and addition are absent from CKAD48, they are included in CKAD49's grammar from the outset. Therefore CKAD49 has NOT learned an unanticipated arbitrary nonlinear physical rule or unrestricted new state feature; no GI/autonomous model claims follow.
